name: pytest
detail: Measured at the pinned head commit on 2026-08-27, not declared, and it fails. The one failure is `tests/test_exports.py::test_public_internal`, which imports mypy and raises `AttributeError: module 'mypy.expandtype' has no attribute 'ExpandTypeVisitor'` — the mypy pinned by this commit's lockfile is incompatible with the Python running it. It is unrelated to the change, which touches only `pydantic/types.py`, and it is present at the base commit too. Recorded as failed rather than as a curated subset: a checks file that says passed when the suite does not is the one thing this corpus cannot contain.
